Charts.dc.html.title: Desktop · Charts that answer the finger

t1.text: Bid 197 · design revisions applied to the dashboard

n1.text: Header: provisional strip above the sticky bar (scrolls away, never shouts), amber status pill, theme button. Hue has two jobs only: route identity and status.

n2.text: Bid page: share-as-text button in the pager, swipe left/right between bids, [ and ] keys. Hero and run order unchanged.

n3.text: Every summary is a control: hero facts, stat tiles, bars, gantt rows and crew-grid names all open the thing they count. Charts read out under the finger.

n4.text: Rows: a 4 px route-colour accent on the number tile for identity; the session stays a text label. Compare outlines the easiest value per row.
